$comment: Generated by `node harness/quality-grades.mjs` (see harness/ENTROPY.md). A = canonical (copy patterns), B = acceptable, C = debt (do not replicate; improve on touch). A file takes the grade of its longest matching unit.

rubric.A: canonical: no lint warnings at all, no source file over 800 lines, at least 1 test per 7 source files (units of 3 files or fewer exempt)
rubric.B: acceptable, minor drift: anything between A and C (e.g. only autofixable lint warnings, one or two large files, too few tests)
rubric.C: known debt, do not copy: 5+ non-autofix lint warnings, or 3+ source files over 800 lines, or no tests in a unit of 10+ source files
